why_zero: 14 of the 15 live actions come from two INDEX pages (7 actions each), and an index page's sentences are not context for one another. The one single-topic document carries one action whose sentence already stood alone.
what_the_first_attempt_did: Before the index rule, context 'recovered' three actions. All three were leaks: 'Introducing JavaScript for Shopify Functions' took the workflow `checkout` from the entry above it, and another took the buyer 'Sidekick app extensionsApp store' — two navigation labels run together. A window widened until a buyer appears will always find one; on an index page it belongs to a different product.

located_next_constraint.what: the seven changelog ENTRY pages — the single-topic documents where context would work — produce ZERO actions, because the announcement is in the page TITLE and the action detector reads only body text
evidence: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
located_next_constraint.grammar: changelog titles are noun phrases and 'now supports' constructions: 'Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics', 'The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers', 'New fields for cash management activities'. None matches an announcement verb pattern.
located_next_constraint.not_shipped_because: adding a title-grammar pattern family would be tuned on 7 positives with no negative corpus, and titles are the noisiest surface on a site — nav labels and section headers share the shape. Wave 9's lesson was to measure both sides first.
